intro: A compact two-level home built around light: a glass-walled living room, an open kitchen, a quiet study, and a bedroom suite upstairs.

lines.text: The living room opens through a full-height glass wall to the west, so the late sun comes right across the oak floor.
The kitchen flows straight off the living room, with a stone-topped island, walnut cabinets and a window over the counter.
The hall takes you from the living room to the stair, with the study just through the door on the right.
The study sits at the back under a wide south window, with room for a desk and a full wall of shelves.
Upstairs, the bedroom has sage green walls and a large west window that fills the room with afternoon light.
The en-suite bathroom is tiled floor to ceiling, with a freestanding tub set under a small high window.
